question.text: The osmotic pressure of blood is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>47</mn></math> bar at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>. To inject glucose to a patient intravenously, it has to be isotonic with blood. The concentration of glucose solution in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>gL</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> is (Molar mass of glucose <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>180</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>083</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>Lbar</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>) (Nearest integer)

solution.text:
